verdict.rationale: The Emerging Companies & Growth practice says it is present in all key US and global venture hubs, including London, Hong Kong and Singapore, and that it advises on hundreds of financings a year for startups and VC investors. This implies cross-border venture reach, but the evidence never explicitly documents cross-border deals. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of international-investor representation, flips/redomiciliations, multi-jurisdiction financing case examples, and independent corroboration of cross-border venture work.
